expected_current: City of Renton data-center moratorium, approved 2026-08-17 according to Renton Reporter; the city’s August 17 agenda identifies the proposed instrument as Ordinance No. 6200 under RCW 36.70A.390.
after: Renton City Council minutes record adoption of Ordinance No. 6200 on 2026-08-17 by roll call, all ayes, after advancement to second and final reading. The ordinance title describes a large-data-center moratorium, declares an emergency and states an immediate effective date. The city’s August 17 agenda identifies RCW 36.70A.390; the full signed ordinance and its operative provisions remain to be verified.

Previously attributed exceptions for pre-effective-date applications and maintenance or repair without expansion remain reported.
